purpose.summary: This is the main program module (P02 screen) of the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt software, handling patient registration (patient master, insurance information, hospitalization records, etc.). It manages screen navigation, data entry, validation, and persistence for patient registration workflows including insurance combinations, hospitalization, and claim processing.

verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP Japanese text, appearing garbled. The ORCA project is a well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt system; this is a genuine production module. The 'online-cics' program_type label is approximate — ORCA uses its own MCP (Message Control Program) GUI framework rather than CICS, but the event-driven screen-handling pattern is analogous. No COMP-3 usage detected despite being a financial/medical billing system, which is unusual but consistent with the ORCA codebase style.
